data.name: Onslaught
data.detailed_description:
⚠️ Photosensitivity / Epilepsy Warning: This game contains fast-paced visuals, flashing lights, and rapid combat effects that may potentially trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

You are a monster on a migration, and a paranoid mining town stands between you and salvation. On your ascent toward Sanctuary, you must survive Betham, a ramshackle city suspended above a sea of clouds and ruled by a brutal regime.

Hunted as the town’s most wanted, fight, climb, and carve your way upward through tightly designed vertical environments filled with enemies, hazards, and limited resources. Every encounter is a test of positioning, timing, and survival.

Engage in fast-paced third-person gunplay, manage scarce resources, and adapt your combat strategy as increasingly dangerous enemies block your path. Explore the streets of Betham and descend into eerie mines to uncover new routes, face escalating threats, and continue your climb.

The only way forward is up.

• Engage in fast-paced third-person combat with responsive gunplay and enemy encounters
• Traverse vertical environments using climbing and movement mechanics to reach new areas
• Manage limited resources to survive increasingly difficult encounters
• Explore interconnected areas, from the streets of Betham to dangerous underground mines
• Face escalating enemy threats that challenge your strategy and skill

data.short_description: Onslaught is an action-adventure game set in a western mining civilization. Explore a dangerous town, descend into eerie mines, and fight to survive a brutal world bent on mining and murder. Surrounded by enemies, there is only one path to salvation: up.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2080 TI/AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 11 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Hardware vendor officially supported drivers. For development: IL2CPP scripting backend requires Visual Studio 2015 with C++ Tools component or later and Windows 10 SDK.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Window 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3080 + higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 11 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Hardware vendor officially supported drivers. For development: IL2CPP scripting backend requires Visual Studio 2015 with C++ Tools component or later and Windows 10 SDK.

content_descriptors.notes: The main mature content that could be seen in our game is the action of shooting and killing NPCs with a weapon. While they also can shoot and kill the character as well.
